summary.text: Melissa Couture is the Libertarian candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent JA Moore (D) and Heather Hickman (R).

paragraphs.text: Melissa Couture advanced from the Libertarian Party convention for South Carolina House of Representatives District 15 on April 11, 2026.

She ran as the Libertarian candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 114 in the 2018 general election, receiving 633 votes (3.9%), and as a nonpartisan candidate for Charleston County School District school board, District 5, in 2022, receiving 1,160 votes (24.5%).
